query: What is the structure of the Horizon Europe programme?
response:
Horizon Europe (HE), with a budget of **€95.5 billion (2021-2027)**, is structured around **three main Pillars** which guide the objectives and types of funding available.

### The Three Pillars of Horizon Europe

#### Pillar I: Excellent Science (€25.8 billion)
This pillar aims to reinforce the EU’s scientific leadership, supporting frontier research and researcher mobility. Funding is generally bottom-up (researcher-driven) and based purely on scientific excellence.

| Component | Focus | Action Types | Target | 
|---|---|---|---|
| **European Research Council (ERC)** | Frontier research, high-risk/high-gain | Starting, Consolidator, Advanced, Synergy Grants | Top individual researchers |
| **Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions (MSCA)** | Researcher mobility, training, and career development | Postdoctoral Fellowships (PF), Doctoral Networks (DN), Staff Exchanges (SE) | Researchers at all stages |
| **Research Infrastructures** | Developing, consolidating, and optimizing world-class research infrastructures | Support to pan-European facilities |

#### Pillar II: Global Challenges and European Industrial Competitiveness (€53.5 billion)
This pillar focuses on collaborative research addressing major societal and policy challenges, driving innovation, and strengthening industrial technology capacity across the EU. This is the largest pillar.

**1. The 6 Thematic Clusters (Collaborative Research):**
Research is organized through defined Work Programmes (RIA, IA, CSA).

| Cluster | Focus Area | 
|---|---|
| **Cluster 1** | Health (HLTH) | 
| **Cluster 2** | Culture, Creativity & Inclusive Society (CL2) | 
| **Cluster 3** | Civil Security for Society (CL3) | 
| **Cluster 4** | Digital, Industry & Space (CL4) | 
| **Cluster 5** | Climate, Energy & Mobility (CL5) | 
| **Cluster 6** | Food, Bioeconomy, Natural Resources, Agriculture & Environment (CL6) |

**2. The 5 EU Missions (Challenge-Driven Research):**
These are focused, time-bound portfolios of actions with clear, measurable 2030 targets.

*   **Mission Cancer** (Conquering Cancer)
*   **Mission Climate Adaptation** (Adaptation to Climate Change)
*   **Mission Ocean & Waters** (Restore our Ocean and Waters)
*   **Mission Cities** (100 Climate-Neutral & Smart Cities)
*   **Mission Soil** (A Soil Deal for Europe)

#### Pillar III: Innovative Europe (€13.6 billion)
This pillar supports breakthrough innovation and market deployment, aiming to scale up companies and create a favorable innovation ecosystem.

| Component | Focus | Action Types | Target | 
|---|---|---|---|
| **European Innovation Council (EIC)** | Supporting breakthrough, deep-tech innovation | Pathfinder (research), Transition (proof-of-concept), Accelerator (scale-up funding/equity) | Start-ups and SMEs |
| **European Innovation Ecosystems (EIE)** | Connecting regional and national innovation actors | Networking, scaling up innovation capacity | Innovation stakeholders |
| **European Institute of Innovation & Technology (EIT)** | Integrating research, education, and innovation through Knowledge and Innovation Communities (KICs) | Entrepreneurship, education, cross-border cooperation | Education and business communities |

---

### Actionable Resources

🎯 **Getting Started with Horizon Europe:**
• Register on [EU Funding & Tenders Portal](https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/home)
• Review the [Work Programmes](https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/how-to-participate/reference-documents;programCode=HORIZON) for your cluster
• Check eligibility via [How to Participate](https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/how-to-participate/how-to-participate/1)
• Find partners using [Partner Search](https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/how-to-participate/partner-search)
• Browse [Call Calendar](https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/opportunities/calls-calendar)
